mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is rising in early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0%, it indicates a tightening cycle with persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate an overheating economy that is likely to trigger a policy response or slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is high in late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
